plan.analysis: Round 1 baseline: inclusion catastrophic (recall ~0.10-0.15, 161/179 missed), scratches weak (0.47, 55 missed), patches decent (0.66, 51 missed). Miss profiles are small + low-contrast: inclusion misses are tiny (median 37px vs 90px train) faint thin streaks; scratches misses are short thin bright lines (42px vs 73px); patches misses are small dark blobs (50px vs 85px). Plan: shift all classes to smaller paste scales with prefer_small weighting, allocate the bulk of the 50-image budget to inclusion while keeping scratches and patches fed (shared detector). Corrected inclusion source list to valid IDs (287 -> 297).
plan.rationale: Inclusion gets 25/50 because recall is near zero and misses are dominated by small (37px) low-contrast thin streaks: I use all valid thin-streak sources (incl. bright thin streak 297 for the few bright misses) and scale 0.35-0.95 with prefer_small so pastes land in the 30-90px band the detector fails on. Scratches (15) target short thin bright lines: thin-line sources only (avoiding thick weld-like streaks), scale 0.30-0.80 to hit the ~42px missed size. Patches (10) keep the class fed with small dark/faint blobs (incl. faint small sources 240, 39, 63, 94) at 0.40-1.00. Same-class backgrounds keep pastes realistic; max_overlap 0.15 avoids clutter. All classes stay >=10 and no class exceeds the 105 cap.

plan.analysis: Preview check vs misses: inclusion pastes are thin faint streaks (vertical + a few horizontal) on gray/white backgrounds, matching the tiny (37px) low-contrast streak misses; sizes land in the 30-90px band. Patches pastes are compact dark blobs on gray/white, matching the 50px dark-blob misses. Scratches pastes are short thin bright vertical lines on gray, matching the 42px thin bright-line misses. All pastes look realistic (feathered, plausible contrast), none wasted on a class, none unrealistically large or thick. Plan is sound; repeat unchanged.
plan.rationale: Previews confirm the pastes match the missed-defect appearance per class: thin faint streaks for inclusion, compact dark blobs for patches, short thin bright lines for scratches, all at the small scales the detector currently fails on. Same-class backgrounds keep them realistic; max_overlap 0.15 avoids clutter. Inclusion keeps the largest share (25) given near-zero recall; scratches 15 and patches 10 keep the shared detector fed. All classes >=10 and within the 105 cap. Repeating the validated plan.
